799:> **MCPJam account limit vs. provider throttle** — If the session pane shows a billing or credit message instead of this card,
the limit is on your MCPJam account, not your provider key. Adding credits or switching to BYOK resolves that case; the steps abo
ve do not apply.

t`
820-MCPJam refused the call before it reached a provider. For the daily, monthly,
832-**Next steps**
834:* **Free plan (owner)** — The limit dialog shows **Compare plans** to upgrade, and **Learn more about BYOK** to understand how
provider keys and MCPJam credits work separately.
835-* **Free plan (admin or member)** — The dialog shows a **Request upgrade** link to email an organization owner.
836:* **Paid plan (owner or admin)** — The dialog shows **Buy credits** to add shared credits to your organization.
837:* **Paid plan (member)** — The dialog shows a **Request credits** link to email an organization owner.
838-* Add your own API key under **Settings → LLM Providers** for chat (BYOK does not cover Swarm, Evals, or other MCPJam-billed f
eatures).
839-* If your organization uses its own keys for all AI features, model tokens are billed by its providers instead; see [Organizat
ion AI key policy](#organization-ai-key-policy).
841-**Swarm and Eval runs**
843:When credits run out during a Swarm or Eval run, blocked work stops and you receive one credit-exhaustion prompt per run, or o
ne per swarm when a swarm launches several runs at once. Completed results are preserved. Buying credits does not automatically re
start the run — start a new run once credits are available.
845-> [!WARNING]
847-> Bring-your-own-key covers chat. Swarm persona generation and persona-driver
850-> for all AI features runs those turns on its default AI model instead, and its
851-> providers bill their tokens; see
852-> [Organization AI key policy](#organization-ai-key-policy).
854:### Credits temporarily held
856:A swarm session can stop with **Credits temporarily held**. The balance is not
857-empty: other requests from your organization were in flight and held the
858:remaining credits until they finish. No credit prompt opens for it and nothing
859-needs buying.
